title: Packages left in unsafe or exposed delivery locations
situation: 20 customers report packages left vulnerable to weather or theft, requiring immediate delivery feedback and goodwill compensation.
hypothesis: packages left in unsafe locations by drivers

params.reply_en: We are sorry your packages were left in an unsafe spot. We have credited 50 SAR to your account for the trouble and flagged this driver with our delivery team.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن ترك شحناتكم في مكان غير آمن. لقد أضفنا رصيداً بقيمة 50 ريالاً إلى حسابكم وأبلغنا فريق التوصيل بهذا الخطأ.

actions.why: Acknowledge the delivery failure and provide immediate compensation.

params.reason: Packages left in unsafe or exposed locations

actions.why: Compensate for the poor delivery experience.
